description: This is an HTML file implementing the front-end UI for a database visualizer, including styling, structure, and client-side scripting for fetching and displaying database, table, and data information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar with clickable database entries.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases when the user triggers a refresh.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data, including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content on user interaction.
